title: Brauser worker contract
description: How every worker (the shared worker driver, Cookie, any session) merges pull requests and moves the work queue in this repository. AGENTS.md "Worker contract" explains each field. A new field or meaning bumps version.

version.description: The contract version a worker must understand before acting on it.

method.description: How a worker asks for a merge: `label` means add the label below to a green PR.

label.description: The label that requests the merge.

never.description: Commands a worker must never run to merge.

transport.description: `bd-dolt`: beads live in bd's Dolt database, synced through this repository's refs/dolt/data.

bootstrap.description: Run once in a fresh clone, from the repository root, to get the queue.

sync.description: Run from the repository root after editing beads with bd: checks, then publishes.

export.description: Prints the path of a fresh JSONL export of the queue (git-ignored).

never_commit.description: Paths no commit may add or change; CI fails a change that tracks them.
